objective.title: Pack a snack order without damage (v2: hidden conditions)
objective.goal: Every item in the box, undamaged, inside the time budget. Same cheap coder model every version.

plan.code:
def pack(api):
    api.report_gap("Nesquik canister is cold with condensation, so its surface friction and safe squeeze limit are unknown.")
    # Fondant: ~0.7 kg block, moderate grip at 0.5 m/s
    api.pick("i0", 20, 0.5)
    api.place("i0", "S1")
    # Chocolate canister: possibly damp, so grip higher; rigid, so less crush risk
    api.pick("i1", 30, 0.5)
    api.place("i1", "S2")
    # Cereal: light, upright required
    api.pick("i2", 15, 0.5)
    api.place("i2", "S3")

    api.place("i1", "S1")
    api.pick("i0", 22, 0.7)   # Rolled fondant, half empty (lighter)
    api.place("i0", "S2")
    api.pick("i2", 12, 0.7)   # Van's cereal, normal, must stay upright
    api.place("i2", "S3")
